title: Revisable Delegation Record
description: One append-only record in an institution's account of what it believed, what it could do, what it had authorized, what it did, what diverged, and what it revised. Defined by STD-07 (https://ethotechnics.org/standards/std-07-revisable-delegation-record). Records are never edited; a later record supersedes an earlier one.

schema_version.description: Version of this record shape. Consumers pin a minor version and must not silently drop records carrying an unknown kind.

record_id.description: Stable identifier, unique within the emitting system. Recommended form: <system>:<kind>:<local-id>. Never reused, even after supersession.

kind.description: Which step of the loop this record belongs to. belief: what the institution holds to be the case. capability: what an assembled human-machine system can do. authorization: which capability has been delegated, to whom, under what ceiling. action: something done under an authorization. discrepancy: observed divergence from an assumption. revision: a record replaced because an assumption failed. objection: a challenge raised by someone with standing. outcome: what an action produced.

id.description: Emitting system, e.g. whether, ambit, nextconsensus, refract.

origin.description: Where the record can be fetched or verified.

on_behalf_of.description: The principal this actor acts for, when the actor is a delegate. The delegation chain is the sequence of on_behalf_of links.

subject.description: What the record is about: a proposition, a capability, an action surface, a page, a lever. Free text or URI.

summary.description: One plain-language sentence a person can read without the content block.

as_of.description: The moment in the world the record describes. For a belief, the time the belief was held about; for an action, when it was taken.

recorded_at.description: When the record was written. Always distinguished from as_of so a later reader can tell a contemporaneous record from a reconstruction.

available_at.description: When the evidence behind the record became available to the actor. Required for a belief that will later be scored.

valid_until.description: Declared expiry. A record past valid_until is stale, not wrong; it needs a revision or a renewal.

content.description: Kind-specific body. The per-kind shapes are enforced by the conditional blocks below.

depends_on.description: record_ids this record rests on. An authorization depends on the beliefs and capabilities that justified it; an action depends on its authorization.

condition.description: A checkable statement which, if it becomes true, means this record no longer holds.

check.description: Where the condition can be evaluated.

clock.description: ISO 8601 duration within which a matching discrepancy must produce a revision or an objection.

invalidated_by.description: The evidence that would invalidate this record. Empty means the emitter has not said what would change its mind.

authorization_record.description: record_id of the authorization this record was produced under.

clauses.description: Clause citations, e.g. STD-07.2.1, STD-02.1.1, pinned by version in the emitting system's manifest.

supersedes.description: record_id this record replaces. The earlier record stays in the log unchanged.

visibility.description: Who may read the record. A public record is citable; an internal record is auditable inside the institution; a private record is tenant data.

standing.description: Who may object to this record, in plain language: a role, a population, or 'anyone'.

channel.description: Where an objection record is accepted.

reversal_clock.description: ISO 8601 duration within which an accepted objection must produce a revision or a reasoned refusal.

hash.description: SHA-256 over the canonical serialization: the record without its integrity block, keys sorted recursively, no insignificant whitespace, UTF-8.

prior_hash.description: Hash of the previous record in the same system's stream. Chains the log.

signature.description: Optional detached signature over hash, format declared by the emitting system.

state.description: configured means present; verified means a check passed. Availability decisions gate on verified.

ceiling.description: The bound on the delegation: a spend, a count, a blast radius, a duration.

triggered_by.description: record_ids of the discrepancies or objections that forced the revision.

requested.description: What the objector wants: reversal, reconsideration, restriction, withdrawal.

examples.subject: hiring pace
examples.summary: Held hiring at replacement-only under a Guarded Expansion posture.

content.reversal_path: Resume trigger: tightness below 60 for two consecutive weeks.

invalidated_by.condition: tightness score falls below 60 for two consecutive weeks

examples.subject: NCCN NSCLC guideline: sunvozertinib first-line listing
examples.summary: Registered a probability that the guideline lists the drug first-line before the resolution window closes.

content.reference_class: guideline first-line listing within 12 months of pivotal data

invalidated_by.condition: resolution rule met or window closes
